create_ObjectNavDatasetV2: create an ObjectNavDatasetV2 instance with an optional Habitat config to load object navigation episodes
load_from_json: load object navigation dataset episodes from a JSON string into an ObjectNavDatasetV2 instance
serialize_to_json: serialize an ObjectNavDatasetV2 dataset to a JSON string using DatasetFloatJSONEncoder
dedup_goals: deduplicate goals across episodes by category and store them in a goals_by_category dictionary
deserialize_goal: deserialize a serialized goal dictionary into an ObjectGoal with view points and agent state
